producer: Actual SimpleTypeModelBinder and CollectionModelBinder<int> bind FormValueProvider input, including conversion failures, into the shared ActionContext.ModelState. No direct error injection or copied membership loop.
disputed_precondition: A view with object or projected metadata shares the actual bound ModelState; some or all entries lack matching view metadata.
compatibility: All six new producer-to-rendering theory rows pass individually on original and candidate, covering zero, one and two metadata-matched entries.
Exact rendered error order and uniqueness are preserved with empty and mixed matching metadata.
excludePropertyErrors uses the actual prefix-bound error and excludes every other error.
Existing validation-summary cases and the full owning ViewFeatures suite pass.
No public API, defaults, new package configuration or cross-assembly private access changes.

measurement.owner: Actual ValidationHelpers.GetModelStateList through a setup-bound typed delegate, using actual binder-produced ModelState and actual ViewDataDictionary metadata.
measurement.controls: Aligned metadata avoiding fallback; model-error-only path; small bound collections.
measurement.early_stop: One comparison is sufficient for a clear large improvement around 50 percent or more, retaining every regression and allocation cost.
measurement.scope: Helper CPU and managed allocations, not HTTP throughput. Actual rendering compatibility is separately exercised.
measurement.exclusions: Native IIS, hosted HTTP parsing, browser workflows, and composition with other independent optimization branches.

history.note: The original contract explicitly includes errors outside model metadata; the optimization must not discard them.
